message.content: Could you let me know what kind of apartment you’re looking at (e.g., studio, one‑bedroom, two‑bedroom) and which part of New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, etc.)? That will help me give you a more accurate estimate.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "紐約租一間公寓的費用是多少？" which translates to "What is the cost of renting an apartment in New York?" They want the cost. We have a tool to calculate construction cost, but not rental cost. There's no tool for rental cost. So we cannot use the tool. We should respond with an estimate or say we don't have enough info. The user didn't provide details like apartment size, location, etc. We can ask clarifying questions. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question. So we should ask: "Could you specify the type of apartment (studio, one-bedroom, etc.), location within NYC, and any other preferences?" That is a clarifying question.
